source_datasets.access_limits: Istat SDMX endpoint rate limit: about five queries per minute per IP; cached source used for builds.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: The committed product contains derived regional percentages and source attribution; raw SDMX responses stay in gitignored data/raw/it_practice/.
source_datasets.notes: Rows use DATA_TYPE 6_WEEK_RELIG and 6_NEVER_RELIG, MEASURE HSC (per 100 people with the same characteristics), SEX 9, AGE Y_GE6, EDU_LEV_HIGHEST 99, and LABOUR_PROFESS_STATUS_B 99. The denominator is resident population aged 6 and over; 6-13 responses are supplied by parental proxy. Source years are 2001-2003 and 2005-2025; 2004 is not present in the source pull.

indicators.label: Weekly attendance %
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field name used for the headline practice metric: persons aged 6 and over by frequency of a place of worship in the last 12 months: at least once a week. This value is self-reported attendance at a place of worship at least once a week; it is not religious affiliation.
indicators.method: ISTAT AVQ DATA_TYPE 6_WEEK_RELIG, MEASURE HSC, total sex, age 6+, total education, total occupation.
indicators.quality_notes: Resident population aged 6+; respondents aged 14+ answer directly, and for children aged 6-13 a parent answers by proxy. The published value is already a percentage. Sampling-error bands are not machine-readable in the SDMX pull; they are documented in the annual Nota metodologica.

indicators.label: Never attending %
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field name used for the secondary practice metric: persons aged 6 and over by frequency of a place of worship in the last 12 months: never. This value is the share reporting never attending a place of worship, and it is not a no-religion affiliation category.
indicators.method: ISTAT AVQ DATA_TYPE 6_NEVER_RELIG, MEASURE HSC, total sex, age 6+, total education, total occupation.
indicators.quality_notes: Resident population aged 6+; respondents aged 14+ answer directly, and for children aged 6-13 a parent answers by proxy. The published value is already a percentage. Sampling-error bands are not machine-readable in the SDMX pull; they are documented in the annual Nota metodologica.

visual_layers.label: Weekly attendance %
visual_layers.description: Self-reported weekly attendance at a place of worship, percent of resident population aged 6+.
visual_layers.notes: This layer reports survey-practice rather than affiliation.

visual_layers.label: Never attending %
visual_layers.description: Self-reported never attending a place of worship, percent of resident population aged 6+.
visual_layers.notes: This layer reports non-attendance in a survey-practice table rather than census no-religion affiliation.
